settings.invalidPhoneWarning: This doesn't look like a valid number — save anyway?
settings.languageDescription: Select your preferred language for the AGAP interface.

home.quickActions: Help and information, one tap away.
home.noCachedLocation: No cached location available yet. Press "Refresh My Location" to save.
home.emergencyDescription: Press the button below to request immediate CDRRMO emergency response. Works offline and on degraded signals.

sos.title: Need urgent help?
sos.description: Hold the SOS button for 2 seconds to ask for help.
sos.holdSosAria: Hold for 2 seconds to send an SOS request
sos.sentDetail: Stay where it is safe, if you can.
sos.queuedMessage: Your request has not reached anyone yet.
sos.queuedDetail: Keep AGAP open and reconnect when you can.
sos.statusPendingDetail: Your request has been received and is waiting for a responder team to be assigned.
sos.statusPendingStaleDetail: No responder has acknowledged your request yet. Keep your phone reachable, and move to higher ground if conditions worsen.
sos.statusRespondingDetail: A rescue team has been assigned to your request — dispatch has been confirmed.
sos.statusResolvedDetail: Responders have completed this request. Stay safe.
sos.completeBody: Responders have completed this request. Keep your reference number in case you need to follow up.
sos.channelsTitle: Don't rely on this app alone
sos.channelsBody: AGAP coordinates your request — it does not replace traditional emergency channels. If you can call or text 911 or your barangay hotline, contact them too.
sos.batteryTip: Power and network can fail in disasters. Between checks, put your phone in airplane mode to save battery, then check for updates every 30 minutes.
sos.osSosTip: Your phone's built-in emergency SOS (press the power button 5 times) can call for help even with no signal — use it too.
sos.statusQueuedDetail: This request has NOT reached anyone yet. It is saved on this phone and will be sent automatically if the network returns. If you can send a text, do it now.
sos.truthTitle: Your request has not reached anyone
sos.truthBody: This phone has no connection, so the request is saved here and cannot be delivered yet. It will send automatically if the network returns — but do not wait for that. Use the buttons below to reach responders through channels that can still work.
sos.truthRelay: If a responder reaches you, show them this:
sos.expectationBody: Sending an SOS does not guarantee immediate rescue. Response depends on hazard severity, responder safety, weather conditions, and resource availability. Your request is received, prioritized, and monitored by emergency responders.
sos.gateBody: AGAP is not an ambulance or an instant rescue service. Help may take time, and rescue may not be possible while conditions are dangerous. Your request will be received and prioritized — but immediate help is not guaranteed.
sos.gateConfirm: I understand — help is NOT guaranteed. Send SOS
sos.gateAria: Confirmation required before sending an SOS
sos.updateSubtitle: Keep your request accurate — responders act on this information.
sos.updateSuccess: Status updated. Thank you for keeping your request accurate.
sos.updateFailed: Couldn't update — check your connection and try again.
sos.guidanceTitle: What to do while you wait
sos.guidanceBody: Open step-by-step safety guidance for your situation.
sos.rescueConfirmBody: Confirming marks your request as Rescue Completed, so responders can focus on others. Only confirm if a responder or official is with you.
